learned_patterns.pattern: PRD-STRUCTURE: Use invoiceforge addendum as the most complete template for product addendums
SPEC-RUN-THE-BOUNDARY-TEST: when a BA sets an objective scope test (ASM-005), run it inside the spec and publish the failures rather than asserting the boundary holds
CLARIFY-LEDGER: record every ambiguity resolution with its disposition so a later reader can tell a decision from an oversight; leave open items only where the owner is genuinely outside the agent

PRD-NEW-ID-NAMESPACE: when a companion spec owns FR/NFR/SC, give PRD acceptance criteria their own AC-xxx namespace and cite the spec IDs rather than restating or renumbering them; verify every citation exists by script before commit
